# Third-party code

These files are verbatim copies of the organisers' public Kaggle notebook
[Self_Evaluation_Notebook](https://www.kaggle.com/code/azimahmadzadeh/self-evaluation-notebook)
by Azim Ahmadzadeh (competition host). The notebook page states: "This Notebook has been
released under the Apache 2.0 open source license." The licence text is in
`LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt`.

| File | Copied part | Change |
|---|---|---|
| `tests/official_selfeval.py` | imports, helper cell and PQ cell | an added module docstring; the line `import matplotlib.pyplot as plt` removed |
| `scripts/official_plots.py` | plotting cell (code cell 4) | an added module docstring and the imports it needs |

These files keep the Apache 2.0 licence. The rest of the repository is under the MIT licence
(`LICENSE`).
